CommunityApplications.Profile:
This repository hosts the Unraid Community Applications template for **hikvision-unifi-fire-bridge**: a Rust daemon that bridges Hikvision thermal-camera fire-detection events into a UniFi Protect Alarm Manager incoming webhook (siren, priority push notification, or any other Protect-supported action).
Source code, documentation, and support: https://github.com/Gasmanc/hikvision-unifi-fire-bridge
